clips.title: Find and inspect a saved costing
clips.description: Search for the demo fabric and open its saved cost breakdown. Review the original production cost, selling price, margin and quantity.

clips.title: Reuse a costing and change assumptions
clips.description: Choose Use to reopen the saved snapshot. Change the weaving rate to Rs 16/m and target margin to 20%, then inspect the new live result.

clips.title: Save a new version
clips.description: Save New Version creates costing v2 while preserving v1 and its original numbers.

clips.title: Select two versions
clips.description: Enable Compare, open the fabric's history, and select v1 and v2 for comparison.

clips.title: Explain the difference
clips.description: Open Compare Costings to inspect the differences in cost components, selling price, margin and profit.

clips.title: Export a cost sheet or customer quotation
clips.description: Preview and download the internal cost sheet. Switch to Customer Quotation, enter a demo buyer and terms, and download a quotation that hides internal costs and margins. Nothing is sent to a customer.
